Filename: Towards adversarial robustness via debiased high-confidence logit alignment
PaperInfo: Kejia Zhang, Juanjuan Weng, Shaozi Li, and Zhiming Luo. "Towards adversarial robustness via debiased high-confidence logit alignment." In Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision, pp. 2783-2792. 2025.

Citations.Text: Wei et al. [42] developed Class-wise Calibrated Fair Adversarial Training (CFA), which adaptively configures training for each class to achieve category-level robust fairness.
Citations.Analysis: 描述了被引论文的方法和目的，但没有特别评价或深入参考。
在表格中列出CFA方法的性能数据，作为比较的一部分，没有特别评价。
结合了被引论文的方法CFA，构建了新方法DHAT-CFA，并展示了其性能。

Recent advancements in AT have introduced several
techniques to further improve adversarial robustness. Wu
et al. [44] introduced Adversarial Weight Perturbation
(AWP), which enhances robustness by flattening the loss
landscape with respect to input variations.
Kim et al.
[20] proposed Feature Separation and Recalibration (FSR)
to capture useful logits from non-robust features.

each class to achieve category-level robust fairness. Li et al.
[26] proposed SGLR, which uses self-distillation to refine
the soft-label distribution logits, thereby calibrating the ad-
versarial training.
